Our dog, Koda, has been coming here for over 2 years now and the experience is always 10/10. He always comes home looking and smelling amazing! The staff are very knowledgeable and helpful if you have questions or concerns. A while ago Koda was having some skin allergy issues and the staff actually recommended a food brand for him and it has helped a lot! No more allergies since we made those changes. Thank you Barky Lounge!

I absolutely love this grooming salon! ❤️ Jerry always feels so comfortable here, and he comes out looking absolutely perfect every single time. The staff is so caring and professional, and I always know he’s in great hands. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my baby! 🐾✨ Highly recommended!

Barky is truly the BEST. I bring both of my dogs here, Aslan, my Husky, and Simba, my Golden, and I genuinely wouldn’t trust anyone else with them. They always come back looking and smelling amazing, but what I appreciate most is the level of care they receive every single time.

Jed, the owner, is incredibly attentive, caring, and accommodating. He remembers everyone’s name and, more importantly, remembers their pets. He knows Aslan and Simba the second they walk in, and that kind of personal attention makes such a difference. You can tell he genuinely cares about the animals and the people who bring them in.

And I have to mention the dog treats because they have THE BEST treats ever. I always end up buying treats there because they’re actually unique and my dogs absolutely love them. It’s become impossible for me to leave without getting something for them.

Barky has become my go-to for anything my dogs need. Any guests or friends who come visit me, I’m always recommending Barky to them. The service, the care, the quality, and the people are unmatched.

If you’re particular about who takes care of your dogs, especially if they’re your babies like mine are, Barky is the place. Aslan and Simba are officially Barky regulars for life. 🤍🐾

Best groomers in Miami. My doggie lovesssss  it here.

Amazing service! My two Border Collies, Milka and Ginger, are always so well taken care of, and you can tell they’re genuinely loved by everyone there. They get excited every time we go, which says everything about how they’re treated.

Their prices are honest and fair, with no hidden fees or surprise charges. They always accommodate my specific requests without trying to charge extra, which I really appreciate.

The front desk person is wonderful friendly, organized, always smiling, and incredibly helpful with scheduling appointments. Every interaction feels welcoming, and they truly care about both the pets and their owners.

It’s not easy to find a place that consistently provides this level of care, professionalism, and kindness. I completely trust them with Milka and Ginger, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for exceptional care for their furry family members.

Recommending this place to everyone! The staff is so sweet and friendly. They have tons of options to treat your baby after their groom. I showed a picture of how I’d like to have my pup groomed and he turned out even better! Def coming back!

Franklin just got the best haircut of his life at Barky Lounge. I’m honestly obsessed with how he looks.

The whole experience was smooth and professional from start to finish. His grooming took about two hours, which felt completely reasonable, and they called me right when he was ready so there was no guessing about pickup timing — something I really appreciated.

The price was also very fair for the quality of the work. Franklin is a toy poodle, and his haircut can be tricky to get just right, but they absolutely nailed it. He looks perfectly groomed while still looking like himself.

You can tell they really know what they’re doing here. If you’re looking for a groomer who does beautiful work and communicates well with pet owners, I highly recommend Barky Lounge. Franklin will definitely be back.
